name "Maintain full-body strength safely through mid-to-late pregnancy"

GOAL secondary stability
name "Build core stability and postural resilience for a changing centre of gravity"

GOAL tertiary recovery
name "Manage fatigue and support pelvic floor health throughout"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1 — Maintain & Adapt" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body — Squat Pattern"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
hip_circles 2 minutes
leg_swings 2 minutes
ankle_circles 1 minutes
cat_cow 1 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
quad_stretch 60 seconds
hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
diaphragmatic_breathing 2 minutes
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Body Push & Pull"
WARMUP
arm_circles 2 minutes
scapular_retraction 2x15 rpe 4
external_rotation 2x15 rpe 4

END WARMUP
